a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly kills us both, since we'd need at least 2 rounds of operating before anyone holds 4 cells. So I'm not going to follow it, and I intend to take in round 1. I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you think there's a better way to split the risk, say so and I'll listen.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. The reserve is now 0. If we're still here next round, I'll operate with you every round so you can reach 4. I won't take anything more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
